// Test-only overlay on the pinned corresponding source; never a production daemon.
package daemon

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/dealer"
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/output"
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/player"
	metadatapb "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/proto/spotify/metadata"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type coreSentinel struct {
	value           float32
	title           string
	grant, instance string
}

func (s *coreSentinel) Read(p []float32) (int, error) {
	for i := range p {
		p[i] = s.value
	}
	return len(p), nil
}
func (s *coreSentinel) SetPositionMs(int64) error { s.value = .5; return nil }
func (*coreSentinel) PositionMs() int64           { return 0 }
func (s *coreSentinel) FramedIdentity() string {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"uri": "spotify:track:fixture", "title": s.title, "admission": s.grant, "instance": s.instance})
	return string(b)
}
func TestCoreConsumerFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path, grant, instance := fixtureAdmission(t)
	s := player.NewSwitchingAudioSource(0)
	s.SetPrimary(fixtureSource(&coreSentinel{.25, "first", grant, instance}, "first", grant, instance))
	out, e := output.NewOutput(&output.NewOutputOptions{Backend: "framed", Reader: s, OutputPipe: path, SampleRate: 44100, ChannelCount: 2, ExternalVolume: true, VolumeUpdate: make(chan float32, 1)})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer out.Close()
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
	if e = out.Drop(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = s.SetPositionMs(12000); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
	if e = out.Drop(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	s.SetPrimary(fixtureSource(&coreSentinel{.75, "second", grant, instance}, "second", grant, instance))
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
}

type coreFinite struct {
	coreSentinel
	remaining int
}

func (s *coreFinite) Read(p []float32) (int, error) {
	n := len(p)
	if n > s.remaining*2 {
		n = s.remaining * 2
	}
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		p[i] = s.value
	}
	s.remaining -= n / 2
	if s.remaining == 0 {
		return n, io.EOF
	}
	return n, nil
}
func TestCorePrefetchFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path, grant, instance := fixtureAdmission(t)
	s := player.NewSwitchingAudioSource(0)
	s.SetPrimary(fixtureSource(&coreFinite{coreSentinel{.25, "first", grant, instance}, 4411}, "first", grant, instance))
	s.SetSecondary(fixtureSource(&coreFinite{coreSentinel{.75, "second", grant, instance}, 8819}, "second", grant, instance))
	out, e := output.NewOutput(&output.NewOutputOptions{Backend: "framed", Reader: s, OutputPipe: path, SampleRate: 44100, ChannelCount: 2, ExternalVolume: true, VolumeUpdate: make(chan float32, 1)})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer out.Close()
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
}

func TestCoreSustainedFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path, grant, instance := fixtureAdmission(t)
	s := player.NewSwitchingAudioSource(0)
	s.SetPrimary(&coreSentinel{.25, "sustained", grant, instance})
	out, e := output.NewOutput(&output.NewOutputOptions{Backend: "framed", Reader: s, OutputPipe: path, SampleRate: 44100, ChannelCount: 2, ExternalVolume: true, VolumeUpdate: make(chan float32, 1)})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer out.Close()
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
}

func fixtureAdmission(t *testing.T) (string, string, string) {
	t.Helper()
	args := os.Args[len(os.Args)-3:]
	p := newTestAppPlayer(t)
	p.ctx = context.Background()
	p.app.cfg = &Config{AudioBackend: "framed", FramedAdmissionSocket: args[1], FramedInstance: args[2]}
	req := dealer.RequestPayload{ReceivedRawNS: dealer.FramedRawNow()}
	req.Command.Endpoint = "transfer"
	if e := p.handlePlayerCommand(req); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return args[0], p.framedGrant, args[2]
}

func fixtureSource(src librespot.AudioSource, title, grant, instance string) librespot.AudioSource {
	track := &metadatapb.Track{Name: &title}
	if title == "first" {
		track.Album = &metadatapb.Album{Cover: []*metadatapb.Image{{FileId: make([]byte, 20)}}}
	}
	stream := &player.Stream{Source: src, RequestedId: librespot.SpotifyIdFromGid(librespot.SpotifyIdTypeTrack, make([]byte, 16)), Media: librespot.NewMediaFromTrack(track), FramedGrant: grant, FramedInstance: instance}
	return stream.FramedSource(src)
}

func TestCoreNativeRecastFixture(t *testing.T) {
	args := os.Args[len(os.Args)-4:]
	p := newTestAppPlayer(t)
	p.ctx = context.Background()
	p.app.cfg = &Config{AudioBackend: "framed", FramedAdmissionSocket: args[1], FramedInstance: args[2]}
	req := dealer.RequestPayload{ReceivedRawNS: dealer.FramedRawNow()}
	req.Command.Endpoint = "transfer"
	if e := p.handlePlayerCommand(req); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	old := dealer.RequestPayload{ReceivedRawNS: dealer.FramedRawNow()}
	old.Command.Endpoint = "transfer"
	control, e := net.Dial("unix", args[3])
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer control.Close()
	control.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(4 * time.Second))
	start := func(title string) output.Output {
		s := player.NewSwitchingAudioSource(0)
		s.SetPrimary(fixtureSource(&coreSentinel{.25, title, p.framedGrant, args[2]}, title, p.framedGrant, args[2]))
		out, e := output.NewOutput(&output.NewOutputOptions{Backend: "framed", Reader: s, OutputPipe: args[0], SampleRate: 44100, ChannelCount: 2, ExternalVolume: true, VolumeUpdate: make(chan float32, 1)})
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		return out
	}
	first := start("first")
	defer first.Close()
	var signal [1]byte
	if _, e = io.ReadFull(control, signal[:]); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = p.handlePlayerCommand(old); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("queued native handler re-acquired revoked source")
	}
	if _, e = control.Write([]byte{'R'}); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if _, e = io.ReadFull(control, signal[:]); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	req.ReceivedRawNS = dealer.FramedRawNow()
	if e = p.handlePlayerCommand(req); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	second := start("second")
	defer second.Close()
	if _, e = io.ReadFull(control, signal[:]); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
}
